title: Weekend SPY pre-NKD early warning job

the_gap_this_closes.measured: on Friday 2026-08-28 all three evening rungs ran and the provider still did not return that day's close
the_gap_this_closes.silence_window: Friday 17:15 ET to Monday 00:45 ET = 55 hours in which the file is short and nothing looks
the_gap_this_closes.why_00_45_is_not_enough: it fires 25 minutes before the NKD window at 01:10, in the middle of the night, with no time to act

IMMEDIATE_GAP_CLOSED_DURING_THIS_STAGE.observed: spy_daily_live.csv read 2026-08-27 at the start of this stage (04:56 machine) and 2026-08-28 later. File mtime 2026-08-30T05:11:31, row count 2426 -> 2427
what_it_was_NOT: the scheduler - scheduler_0830.log has heartbeats only, and the running scheduler has no Sunday SPY job at all
my test runs - the harness monkeypatches the launcher so nothing spawns, and every regression run happened AFTER 05:11
IMMEDIATE_GAP_CLOSED_DURING_THIS_STAGE.attribution: not determinable from the evidence; most likely a manual operator run. Recorded as measured, not guessed
IMMEDIATE_GAP_CLOSED_DURING_THIS_STAGE.consequence: the IMMEDIATE gap is closed - tonight NKD window has its data either way. What this stage fixes is the STRUCTURAL gap: nothing automatic looks between Friday 17:15 and Monday 00:45

schedule_added.label: SPY_WEEKEND_PRE_NKD_CHECK
schedule_added.cron: day_of_week="sun", hour=18, minute=0  (ET - APScheduler is ET-native)
schedule_added.name: SPY weekend pre-NKD check 18:00 ET (Sunday early warning)
schedule_added.convention_followed: the repo already has a weekend job - the Sunday 18:30 ET stop-repair sweep - registered the same way. 18:00 puts the data check half an hour BEFORE the protection sweep, so one Sunday log reads in order: is the data there, then is the book protected

required_date_logic.pinned_by_test: the job's code is parsed, its docstring stripped and its string literals blanked, then scanned for weekday()/timedelta/friday. Proven to catch a hand-rolled version

verified_cases.Sunday 2026-09-06 before Labor Day: 2026-09-04 - skips the Monday holiday and lands on the Friday, with no special case in the job

behaviour.already_covered: logs 'nothing to do' and calls NO provider - asserted by test
behaviour.recovered: WARNING naming that the Friday ladder was late and the weekend recovered it
behaviour.still_missing: ERROR naming the required day, the day the series ends on, the 01:10 window it stops, the remaining 00:45 attempt, and the manual command
behaviour.provider_failure: stays fail-closed - no RECOVERED, the shortfall is still reported

dashboard_and_journal.schedule_mirror: monitor/backend/schedule_status.SUNDAY_SPY_PRE_NKD_SLOT = (6, 18, 0), mirrored in _scheduled_slots_for the same way the Sunday sweep is. Without it the dashboard treats the slot as stray and invents an incident every week
dashboard_and_journal.recovery_stream: a THIRD stream, separate from spy_refresh_pm and spy_last_chance_pre_nkd
dashboard_and_journal.why_separate: folding it into the ladder would let a Sunday success mark a Friday rung recovered - the same fault Stage 5ZZT fixed when a stop-repair sweep was closing failed refreshes. Folding it into the last-chance stream is subtler and still wrong: a Sunday failure that Monday then fixes is a real two-event recovery story

ops_status.weekend_behaviour: when the file is short it names the Sunday job while it is still ahead AND always still names the Monday 00:45 last chance
ops_status.live_line_now: covers 2026-08-28, which is what the next session asks for
ops_status.weekday_behaviour: silent - the evening ladder speaks for itself

covers: asks freshness, never computes the day
Sunday and Monday agree on the day
shortfall logs an error with the manual command
mirror keeps it before the sweep
journal gives it its own job_type

three_failures_pre_existing: 5ZZD test_14_orders_are_still_impossible - asserts the confirmation file is absent; the operator signed it 2026-08-27

three_tests_I_updated_because_MY_change_: 5ZZD test_15: the SPY family is now FIVE jobs, not four - the count in the name grew rather than the assertion being loosened to 'at least four'
dashboard test_sunday_reopen_sweep: Sunday now has two slots, and the ORDER is part of the assertion
dashboard test_the_next_job_after_friday_close: the first thing to look at the data after Friday's close is now this job, which is the whole point
tests.a_test_of_mine_that_was_wrong: my first 'never writes preflight_state' test scanned raw source and matched the DOCSTRING, which mentions preflight_state.json precisely to say it does not write it. Rewritten as an AST walk with the docstring stripped. A second scan then flagged the word 'Friday' in an honest log message, so string literals are blanked too

restart.why_required: APScheduler reads cron only at startup. The running scheduler (pid 34564, started 2026-08-29 09:11:11) predates this code and does not have the job
restart.why_not_done: the brief says not to restart unless explicitly requested

timing_if_restarted_today.job_fires: Sunday 18:00 ET, in ~10.8h (MT Sun 16:00, VN Mon 05:00)

restart.if_not_restarted_before_18_00_ET: the job does not run today and the first automatic attempt remains SPY_LAST_CHANCE_PRE_NKD at Monday 00:45 ET, 25 minutes before NKD 01:10 - exactly the situation this stage was written to remove
